local_construction.counts_scope: Overlapping local construction stages; not public availability, runnable programs or scientific completion.
local_construction.evidence_kind: Independently verified local V57 source installation and current construction records. Internal operational evidence is not republished by this status update.

stage_rules: Definitions, registered packages and preferred source interfaces overlap and must not be summed.
Conditions, cases, folds, source files and versions do not add canonical assignments.
Source and design commits alone do not change these counts or establish scientific readiness.
Published packages retain their own dependency, data, environment and execution limitations.
Historical finite validations are not a current original-full-scope completion count.
